# OCG Usage
**DeepSeek balance and OpenCode Go usage (5-hour / weekly / monthly) merged into one floating pill,
with a matching settings page**
[](README.md) [](README.zh.md)
Changelog · Feedback
*An unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows your DeepSeek balance and OpenCode Go usage (Rolli
ng / weekly / monthly) in one floating pill, with click-to-refresh, border-flash feedback, drag-to-s
nap and a hover popover, plus a full-page settings view of its own.*
## Features
**The pill and the hover popover**
- **OpenCode Go quota amounts + DeepSeek balance display**:
- The balance area on the pill's left can show either the **DeepSeek balance** or the **OCG quota re

maining worked out from a reference model**;
- the OCG model list and quota are fetched automaticall
y, falling back to the bundled model table and quota data when the fetch fails.
- **Three rings show each window's usage**:
- OpenCode Go's three windows are drawn as ring progress indicators, and **clicking the pill refresh

es them**;
- the number in each ring's centre is a percentage (**Used** by default, switchable to **
Left** in settings): > 20% left green / ≤ 20% amber / ≤ 5% red.
- **Hover popover**:
- hovering the pill opens a panel with three separate usage bars showing the percentage and the rese

t time;
- it can also show both balances at once (**DeepSeek account balance** and **OpenCode Go quo
ta left** — either can be switched off on the “Floating pill” tab).
- **OCG quota conversion**:
- pick a **reference model** on the settings page (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash by default; any official Open
Code Go model is available) and the plugin works out the **used / remaining amount** from “that mode
l's **Go-tier** monthly quota × this month's used percentage”, shown both in settings and in the hov

er popover;
- free models read “Free”, unlimited ones “Unlimited”, and the remaining quota and simil
ar figures all show `--` .
- **Amount currency**:
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
- **Host version gate**: the package declares `engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7"`. DSH evaluates it with `semve
r.satisfies(..., { includePrerelease: true })`, so every rc / alpha from 0.1.7 on matches — no plugi

n change is needed for each new host version.
- **Tested**: `dsh 0.2.1-rc.3` and `dsh 0.2.1-rc.5` (i

solated profile cold boot plus a headless-browser smoke, both green).
- **If the host refuses to loa
d the plugin** (narrowed range or a mismatched ledger): grant an exact exemption in the profile's `c
ompatibility.json` instead of changing the plugin:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The file lives at `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/compatibility.json` (desktop: `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\<pro

file>\compatibility.json`).
- After a DSH upgrade, if the pill or settings page misbehaves, check th
e boot log for `plugin tree failed to load` first, then compare against CHANGELOG.md.
## Security & privacy
- **Release assets carry build provenance**: every `.tgz` is built and signed by GitHub Actions, so
the Release page shows **Verified**; verify it yourself with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo ve

rneuil/dsh-opencode-go-usage`.
- **Keys never leave your machine except to the official endpoints**:
the API key is held by DSH settings storage and is only sent as a request header; it is never writt
en into URLs, logs or the usage snapshot, and never projected to the client (the client only sees "c

onfigured?" and a masked form).
- **Only four fixed hosts are contacted at runtime**: `api.deepseek.
com` (balance), `opencode.ai` (usage and the official model table), plus `open.er-api.com` and `api.

frankfurter.app` (exchange rates, only when the currency mode is "auto").
- **No telemetry**: no usa
ge data is collected and nothing is reported to a server of our own; the only third-party package in
volved is the host peer dependency `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, which declares the settings schema an
d its volatile semantics and is installed with the profile so the settings UI behaves identically ev

erywhere.
- **Credential hardening**: every request that carries a key disables redirects (`redirect

: "error"`) so credentials cannot be forwarded to another host.
- **Reporting**: please use GitHub I
ssues; **never paste a key into an issue**.
## Known limitations & disclaimer
- **Unofficial plugin**: this project has **no affiliation whatsoever** with DeepSeek or OpenCode; n
either endpoint is a long-term frozen public contract, so a major upstream change can break it (the
parser already tolerates common variants such as “remaining percentage / used amount and quota / sec

onds to reset”, and on failure the host puts a readable message in `usageError`).
- **Keys stay on t
his machine**: the host half calls the two endpoints above directly and goes through no third party;
a manual key entered in settings is stored in this machine's plugin config, and the UI only ever sh

ows a masked hint (such as `sk-****5590`).
- **Network hiccups**: occasional cross-border HTTPS time
outs are normal. The pill then keeps the **last known values** and the border turns to a warning col

our; the host retries at 3/8/20/40 seconds and recovers automatically.
- **Interface language**: the
pill and the settings page are **bilingual (Chinese / English)** and follow the DSH language settin
g. **Error details** produced by the API layer (such as 401/403 or an unexpected response shape) are

still in Chinese.
- **The quota figure is an estimate**: no official endpoint exposes “how much of
model X is left right now”, so the plugin estimates it as “that model's **Go-tier** monthly quota ×
**this month's used percentage**” — for reference only. The monthly percentage is the **whole plan's
** progress, not that model's own share. The **Go Plus tier is not covered yet** (the Go tier is alw

ays used).
- **The rate only affects display**: the DS balance is originally in CNY and the quota in
USD; conversion is purely cosmetic (`auto` = ¥ in Chinese, ＄ in English) and never changes a real b

ill.
- **The model list can lag**: the bundled snapshot is the official data of 2026-10-31; it updat
es with each refresh while online, and while offline (or when fetching fails) the snapshot is shown

and labelled in the UI.
- **Use at your own risk**: this software is provided “as is” under the MIT
licence, without warranty of any kind.
